Mihir Kallianpur began his tabla training at the age of seven under the guidance of Pt. Prabhakar Betrabet and later received advanced training from Ustad Shabbir Nisar, son of legendary tabla Nawaaz Ustad Shaik Dawood Khan Sahab. He is a gifted and dedicated musician who has won awards and scholarships from prestigious institutions like 'SURSAGAR', Bangalore and the Centre for Cultural Resources and Training, New Delhi. Mihir has performed at many prestigious organizations like Devnandan Ubhayker Yuva sangeet utsav in Bangalore, Bharatiya sangeet vidyalaya in Dharwad, Sawai Gandharva Sangeet Mahotsav in Kundgol, Ustad Abdul Karim Khan Sangeet Mahotsav in Miraj, Harivallabh Sangeeth Samellan in Jalandhar, Suburban music circle in Mumbai and has accompanied several noted vocalists and instrumentalists, earning praise for his sensitive and skillful accompaniment. He is a B high graded artist in All India Radio and has performed in various music festivals in India and the United States. Mihir is recognized as a young musician of outstanding talent and a role model of dedication, hard work, patience, and perseverance.
